# Galaxy Sports Edge (GSE) & Galaxy Sports Institute (GSI)

> Galaxy Sports Edge is a football analysis, player prop, and DFS platform built on 32-team coaching tendencies, offensive and defensive line trench matchups, verified injury and beat-writer reports, Galaxy Sports Institute (GSI) return-to-play sports medicine research, and two-sided de-vigged line comparisons.

## Canonical Sections

- [/](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/): Home platform overview, live NFL boards, and matchup breakdowns.
- [/board](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/board): Official Verified NFL Board (36-13-1 · 73.5% · +20.14u) with XX/100 conviction scores and pass discipline notes.
- [/packages](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/packages): Galaxy Picks pay-per-slate storefront providing plain-English NFL game breakdowns, side/total picks, and player props.
- [/research](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/research): Football Film, Coaching Scheme & GSI Sports Medicine Research hub.
- [/fantasy/dfs](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/fantasy/dfs): DraftKings & FanDuel NFL DFS Lineup Builder with game-script stacking.
- [/resources/card-supplies](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/resources/card-supplies): Pro Card Supplies & Operator Resources directory for grading protection, vault storage, studio desk hardware, and film study.
- [/api/content-os/packet](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/api/content-os/packet): Live Content OS daily fuel packet API serving daily boards, visual packs, attribution partner kits, and creator workflows.
